CORE MATHEMATICS — TERMLY EXAM #1
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 13
   C. 169
   D. 170

2. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 8 cm and 15 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 7
   C. 17
   D. 23

3. In the number 3141, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 40
   C. 400
   D. 10

4. In the number 3541, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 40
   C. 400
   D. 4

5. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 42
   B. 24
   C. 12
   D. 36

6. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 18
   C. 82
   D. 9

7. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 11
   C. 121
   D. 122

8. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 4
   C. 12
   D. 32

9. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 9
   C. 1
   D. 20

10. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 10
   C. 26
   D. 5

11. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 90
   C. 18
   D. 36

12. Solve for x: x + 7 = 17. (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 11
   C. 10
   D. 7

13. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 50
   B. 14
   C. 49
   D. 7

14. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 3
   C. 29
   D. 28

15. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 48
   C. 14
   D. 49

16. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 12
   C. 1
   D. 13

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

20. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

MARKING SCHEME
====

1. C — 169
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: Square = number × number
2. Substitute values: 13² = 13 × 13
3. 13² = 169
Final Answer: 169
Mark reminder: method mark; accuracy mark

2. C — 17
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: c² = a² + b²
2. Substitute values: c² = 8² + 15²
3. c² = 64 + 225

5. c = 17
Final Answer: 17 cm
